displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 10 red flashes
meaning: The gas valve is energized with no call for heat. The main blower and the inducer blower run, and no ignition sequence starts, for as long as this condition exists.
diySteps: If you smell gas, leave and call the gas supplier from outside
Technician: check the gas valve and the gas valve wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not keep resetting a furnace whose gas valve is powered when the thermostat is not calling.
